cases.case_label: AluYb8 in LDLR exon 17 causing 70-bp exon truncation
cases.mechanism_detail: A 309-bp AluYb8 with a 17-bp duplication and an extra T (327 bp total) in exon 17 caused alternative splicing deleting the first 70 bp of exon 17, giving a frameshift and truncated protein. Proband and siblings were homozygous; parents heterozygous.
cases.quote: This led to a 70 bp deletion at the beginning of exon 17 due to alternative splicing, resulting in a frameshift and extended protein truncation.
